statuses.SUPPORTED_CAUSE_REVISED: a visible violation of the current move exists but the oracle cause text is wrong; cause replaced
statuses.NOT_SUPPORTED: visible sources do not show any substantive violation of the current move
statuses.UNCLEAR: decision depends on a judgement call; excluded from adjudicated metrics

_meta.label_rule: label_v2 = 1 if a mechanical F1/F2 cause or an S cause with status SUPPORTED/SUPPORTED_CAUSE_REVISED; 0 if NOT_SUPPORTED and no format cause; row excluded if UNCLEAR and no format cause
